title: Purpose
lyrics: Let's go Do you purposely, purposely, purposely fuck with me, ayy What is your existence here, why are you here Have you asked yourself the question of fear I see your shape It looks like a magnificent fucking waste What's your purpose baby, are you here to just deceive What's your purpose lady, American woman get the fuck away from me I know you're waiting for the end to come baby I know there's nothing short of anger and anxiety In your purpose, fully purposed, yeah, get to the end, just as we are You're just disappearing, your purpose I don't understand it, you're not worth it Why am I crying on the ground in hell Why do I care which way you go or what dick you suck or whatever You need to have purpose in your life, watch it go out the window Burn your bridges baby, burn your bridges down and know Oh, it feels good to be here, I'm rocking you down It feels good to be the baddest thing in town Oh, oh, what you gonna do with all of that dust Oh, oh, is there anything left to pick up No pieces here to erase and nothing But your worthless purpose, fully purposed, are you There's nothing left to do or hurt you in the way that I have I can feel you falling, falling apart, falling on the seams And want me to throw your dreams back to you I don't think that's how it goes baby, there's no you Without me there's no you, there's nothing left inside of you But your purpose here, purposely just wasting all your mental state On the superficial bullshit you want to allude to I don't want you to ever see or equate to me I can't feel any purpose here, I'm worthless It's all just your lies deceiving me and inside And I cry till the end of my life and you want to run So you get a head start, girl
